title: agropyron pinifolium var. sclerophyllum
intro: Agropyron pinifolium var. sclerophyllum, commonly known as Sclerochloa dura, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its health benefits of acting as a bronchodilator and anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Agropyron pinifolium var. sclerophyllum are primarily attributed to its ability to relax the airways, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
